findings.title: Non-array operator string becomes falsely complete after loop union
findings.problem: copiedCanaryEntries wraps non-array string as [string]; runBenchmark unions it into an array before withTextCapture can mark the original category invalid.
findings.violatedRequirement: Design21 WD20-01/WD20-02: invalid operator configuration must remain unavailable without losing required known hits.
findings.requiredCorrection: Carry original invalid-container status through the final immutable per-run union; preserve valid/required hits and optional undefined semantics.
findings.requiredRegression: Actual runBenchmark self-test-host loop with non-array string operator configuration: unavailable/null total/non-PASS for required scope, actual fixture-password hit retained and raw values redacted.
findings.existingTestGap: invalid-operator currently supplies an array containing numeric42, which remains invalid and does not cover normalization of a string container.

acceptedControls: Private actual-client identity/isolated observer and override-preserving fallback
Complete transient consumed-text scan before original size/parse/status refusal
Closed errors/codes and full successful capture before revision validation
Accounting before hard-stop latch and awaited recovery/cleanup
Collector stage at-most-once, sticky known hits/unavailability and safe labels
All-attempt completeness/config gate and explicitly local/null-global report
Mandatory actual fixture-password inclusion and self-mode-only host seam
Corpus semantic validator and stop rule unchanged
